svg.title: Grammar components for temporal graphics in ggplot2 and ggtime
svg.desc: Table matching Wilkinson's grammar to the layered grammar, with the ggplot2 and ggtime elements for each component. Data: ggplot2 POSIXt, Date and hms; ggtime POSIXt, Date, mixtime linear_time and cyclical_time. Aesthetics: x/y time; ggtime adds timeoffset and timeid. Geom: geom_line; geom_time_line, geom_candlestick. Stat: stat_summary_bin; stat_summary_time, stat_ohlc. Scale: scale_*_date, scale_*_datetime; scale_*_mixtime. Scale transform: scales transform_date; transform_warp. Coord: coord_cartesian, coord_radial; coord_loop (cartesian and radial), coord_calendar. Position and Facet have no ggtime elements.
